hourlyRate.description: The month's costs, owner's draw and margin divided by your productive hours

breakdown.title: Monthly total breakdown
breakdown.explanationTitle: How is the hourly rate calculated?
breakdown.explanation: We add the fixed costs, the month's variable costs and the owner's draw, and apply the safety margin to that total. The result is divided by the month's productive hours: available hours per week × 52 weeks ÷ 12 months. The minimum is the same math without the margin.
